rules: Standalone signals: no case, entity or map-line links. Incident date kept apart from report date. Pin = the place the source gives; 'approx.' in the title when only a street, suburb or area is known. Sources that reuse one report or one police statement are not independent corroboration. Being near another pin is not a link. Private individuals (victims and suspects) are not named.

signals.title: Tafelsig, Mitchells Plain (Paulsberg St, approx.): barber shot dead inside his shop, 20 Oct
signals.content: Police say a man was shot inside a barbershop in Paulsberg Street, Tafelsig, at about 20:07 on Tuesday 20 October; according to reports, unknown suspects came out of a minibus taxi and shot at him (police, via Cape Times). He was declared dead at the scene. Mitchells Plain police registered a murder case. Police say the motive is unknown, and no arrest has been reported. Cape Times describes him as a well-known local barber. One report found, resting on police: Cape Times (IOL). A resident quoted in the same article calls the shooting gang-related; police do not. This is not the burnt body found in Tafelsig on 17 October, which is a separate pin.

signals.title: Valhalla Park (Angela St, approx.): man, 21, found stabbed in water, 20 Oct
signals.content: Police say the body of a man of 21 was found in Angela Street, Valhalla Park, at about 07:04 on Tuesday 20 October, with stab wounds to his throat (Sergeant Wesley Twigg, via Daily Voice and TygerBurger). He was declared dead at the scene. Bishop Lavis police registered a murder case; no arrest has been reported. The reports place the body in water, a vlei (Daily Voice) or a canal (TygerBurger), with tyres over it. No source says when he was killed: the date and time are when the body was found. Police give no motive. A name shared online was not verified by TygerBurger, so the victim is not named here. Two reports, both resting on one police account: Daily Voice and TygerBurger.

checked.incident: Body found Tue 20 Oct 2026 at about 07:04 (police, via Daily Voice and TygerBurger). 07:04 is the discovery time; no source gives when he was killed.

The pin is the middle of Angela Street in OpenStreetMap (way 30690124), which OSM labels Nooitgedacht/Elsies River; the street also holds the Valhalla Park Community Centre. It marks the street, not where the body lay.

signals.title: St Montague Village (St Alexander Circle and St Christopher Ave): two men shot dead, 18 Oct
signals.content: Police say two men, aged 37 and 46, were shot dead at the corner of St Alexander Circle and St Christopher Avenue in St Montague Village on Sunday evening, 18 October; Steenberg police responded at about 18:30 (Sergeant Wesley Twigg, via Southern Mail). According to police, two suspects approached the men, opened fire and fled on foot. Police believe the motive may be gang-related. Steenberg detectives are investigating two counts of murder. No arrest has been reported. The victims were not named. One report found, resting on police: Southern Mail; Briefly News mentions the shooting later without new detail. Not the St Montague Village shooting of 7 October, which is a separate pin.

signals.title: Firethorne, near Geelhout St (map point inferred): man, 33, shot dead, 17 Oct
signals.content: Police say a man of 33 was shot dead in Firethorne, near Geelhout Street, at about 23:05 on Saturday 17 October (Lieutenant Colonel FC van Wyk, provincial police spokesperson, via Athlone News). He was walking near a premises when a white vehicle stopped alongside him; the occupants allegedly opened fire and chased him until he collapsed. Bishop Lavis police found his body with gunshot wounds to the chest and head. Bishop Lavis detectives are investigating a murder case; police believe the motive is gang-related. No arrest has been reported. The victim was not named. One report found, resting on police: Athlone News, published 22 October. 'Firethorne' is not a suburb on the map; the pin is on Geelhout Road beside Firethorn Street in Bonteheuwel, an inferred location the article does not give. Not the Loganberry Street, Bonteheuwel, shooting of 18 October in the same article.
